# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: 1970 generic focus effects — scripted effects.
## Generated by tools/generate_1970_generic_focus_tree.py
## Helpers of the 1970 generic focus tree.

# Changes the popularity of one outlook.
# Input: GEN_1970_outlook_start / GEN_1970_outlook_end (MD party index range, end exclusive), GEN_1970_outlook_change.
# The governing party is boosted if it belongs to the outlook, otherwise the most popular party of the outlook.
GEN_1970_change_outlook_popularity = {
	set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_best_index = GEN_1970_outlook_start }
	set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_best_pop = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = ruling_party
				value = GEN_1970_outlook_start
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = { ruling_party < GEN_1970_outlook_end }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_best_index = ruling_party }
	}
	else = {
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = GEN_1970_outlook_start
			end = GEN_1970_outlook_end
			value = GEN_1970_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { party_pop_array^GEN_1970_i > GEN_1970_best_pop } }
				set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_best_pop = party_pop_array^GEN_1970_i }
				set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_best_index = GEN_1970_i }
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { party_index = GEN_1970_best_index }
	set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = GEN_1970_outlook_change }
	set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = GEN_1970_outlook_change }
	change_relative_party_popularity = yes
}

# Changes the global Cold War tension (MDCW, 0-100). Input: GEN_1970_tension_change.
# COLDWAR | wrapper around mdcw_cw_add_tension, the only allowed way to change tension (kept for older callers).
GEN_1970_change_tension = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = GEN_1970_tension_change }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
}
